summary: All 80 genes labeled as upregulated in Figure 5A matched the registered two-hour hypothalamic hypoxia contrast. Registered effects agreed in direction for 78 of 80 genes (97.5%). Bcl11a and Egr4 had negative registered effects. The proposal closes this selected-gene comparison without claiming genome-wide verification. No ledger was edited. [Published Figure 5A](https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.15252/embr.202153083.pdf)
openIssues: Figure 5A reports three to four samples per group. GEO and the registered fit contain four per group. The exact libraries in the authors’ fit remain unidentified.
The paper reports 313 upregulated genes. The figure labels 80, and the peer-review response describes the panel as exhaustive. The selection rule remains unresolved.

The public sources reviewed contain no complete author DESeq2 table or per-gene estimates, P values or FDR for the panel. Magnitude and inference remain unassessed, so no numerical comparison spec was proposed.
